opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record; hold a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award; have teaching and admin duties; based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants covering a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: APEX Awards (Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross-disciplinary research) offer established independent researchers the opportunity to pursue genuine interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven research across the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities, in partnership with the Royal Society, the Royal Academy of Engineering and supported by the Leverhulme Trust.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; no requirement of prior British Academy funding; open to diverse career stages; previous successful recipients not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library, museum (GLAM) organisation or a performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80% of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation; doctorate (Viva Voce) completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027; must be postdoctoral status; no permanent academic post held. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible, or anyone with a UK doctorate, or with strong prior association with the UK academic community.
opportunities.summary: Three-year Postdoctoral Fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards the completion of a significant piece of publishable research, strengthening their experience of research and teaching in an academic environment.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences, ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based Higher Education Institution (HEI) or Independent Research Organisation (IRO) continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Scheme to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination, including quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a humanities/social sciences researcher based at an eligible UK university or research institute with an established role lasting the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status, planning at least 20% time on the award. Involvement of overseas Co-Applicants required; research led by and grounded in humanities/social sciences.
opportunities.summary: International Interdisciplinary Research programme supporting projects led by UK-based humanities and social sciences researchers working with international partners, developing genuinely interdisciplinary projects across SHAPE and STEM disciplines on the theme of Mobilities.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Global Innovation Fellowships provide opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the policy sector, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, addressing foreign and security policy challenges. Up to two one-year fellowships offered.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: Symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers in the humanities and social sciences affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Call for early career researchers in the humanities and social sciences to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', in partnership with the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation, encouraging collaboration and networking with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme, or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months. The applicant must meet the eligibility requirements for the scheme they intend to apply for.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to the amount already requested for research expenses, such as specific equipment to overcome barriers, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support in making applications. Offered on a rolling deadline.
